outcomes.objection: Hecke formalization scope and missing prevention/medium process-audit report
outcomes.outcome: The substantive scope correction was incorporated before finalization. The notebook Verification gate explicitly names the fresh medium reviewer and its process audit. To prevent the general import-scope ambiguity, build formal-import-encoding-audit was added to the living queue: report custom definitions and require explicit source-identification evidence or an unresolved gate. It is queued, not falsely reported implemented.

outcomes.objection: Potential loss of earlier work when the old worktree and branch disappeared
outcomes.outcome: The user explicitly requested a new branch/worktree from main after the old name was absent. The earlier commit IDs are not ancestors of current main, but their corresponding imports are present under rewritten commit IDs. An exact Git diff of the original BMD-import checkpoint against current main for both survey notebooks, results and provenance directories returned exit zero with no differences. No earlier import data was lost. The cause of the original branch/worktree removal was not established and is not attributed.

outcomes.outcome: Wrong as a scope or license objection: three central family-003 papers plus the explicitly announced related cyclotomic Hecke result make four requested relevant manuscripts.
